goal: Branch protection gate: required reviews, passing checks and no direct pushes to main.
use: Branch protection gate: required reviews, passing checks and no direct pushes to main. Use when a repository's default or release branch is configured.

steps.note: List the protected branches and their settings.
Set the rule. At least one independent review and all required checks before merge.
Check direct pushes. Flag branches that allow force pushes or deletion.
Check administrators. Flag administrators who can bypass the rules.
Report. Each branch, its settings, the gaps and the fix.
